prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE landscape 16:9 full-scene watercolor-and-colored-pencil story illustration.
Use all three attached references DIRECTLY. IMAGE 1 IS THE MASTER IDENTITY AND DRAWING STYLE. Replicate its simple almost-circle face, short rounded chin, broad flat hair tufts, thick slightly rough pencil outlines, and compact approximately 2.6-head childlike body. Image 2 is ONLY for open eyes: round eyes with olive irises, dark pupils, tiny highlights and white sclera. Image 3 is the approved current face and soft hand-drawn style, but its village scenery is NOT the requested location.
STRICT MAIN CHARACTER: broad simple round head, short round lower face, tiny dot nose and tiny mouth, two sparse pencil eyebrows; short gray-white hair in a few large solid tufts with broad lime-green tips, NO thin strands or shiny highlight streaks; dark gray headphones with a green ring; plain forest-green kangaroo-pocket hoodie with only a few folds; gray shorts; short bare child legs and bare feet. DO NOT lengthen the body or legs, DO NOT narrow the face, DO NOT turn this into polished anime. Draw this main character with EXACTLY the simple identity-reference construction.
SCENE CONTINUITY: bright conservatory greenhouse, pale wooden window grids, soft distant blue lake and green hills, leafy climbers, pots of tiny white flowers and lavender, two honey-brown wicker chairs with cream cushions, stone floor and muted terracotta woven rug. Main character sits on the LEFT chair. On the RIGHT chair a larger adult woman interviewer, brown hair gathered in a loose bun, coral sweater, cream trousers. She too is softly drawn, no intricate shiny hair or anime rendering. Main character has a small CREAM notebook; interviewer has an OLIVE GREEN notebook and YELLOW wooden pencil. Keep these identities and object colors unambiguous.
RENDERING: visibly matte colored-pencil and loose watercolor on paper. Simple broad watercolor patches, gently irregular pencil lines, modest economical detail. Natural daylight, fresh greens and blue, cream paper, coral; neutral bright light without strong yellow tint. Not glossy, not smooth digital/anime shading. No detailed fine hair, no complex clothing folds.
LAYOUT: single complete 16:9 landscape scene; core faces, both hands and notebooks within y=20–75% so a later subtitle band at y=88–96% cannot hide them. Natural floor, rug, chair legs and plants extend to ALL bottom edges, no blank band. Exactly two people, natural sleeve-wrist-hand attachment, only two arms per person. No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, UI or collage. Sketches are only rough pencil marks.

Moment 1 / follow-up question. A balanced two-person medium-wide shot, with the protagonist left and interviewer right, both fully understandable and not overlapping each other. The interviewer leans forward slightly, glances from the protagonist to her OPEN green notebook, and points her yellow pencil tip at an earlier rough note ON HER OWN NOTEBOOK as she asks a follow-up. Her pointing is specific, pencil lowered toward the note, not a generic palm-up pose. The protagonist holds a CLOSED cream notebook with BOTH hands against the upper lap at about 60% image height, thinks quietly with subtly drawn worried eyebrows and a tiny closed mouth, and looks toward the interviewer. Closed cream notebook is clearly visible, not hiding hands. Keep protagonist eye level near 37%, hands/notebooks around 55–68%, feet lower but clear. Two-person action communicates being asked again and searching memory.
notes: The existing conversation image was visually inspected for setting and interviewer continuity only; omitted from generator inputs to avoid polished anime style contamination.
